landmarks.anatomy: Native proximal radial nail-base corner

modelIndicator.construction: Source fold facet151 is the independently inspected proximal radial base apex. A tiny model membrane retains this corner, rather than mapping it inward to the coarse envelope. Actual phalangeal axes define radial and proximal directions.
limitations: AI teaching membrane, not observed skin or patient precision.
0.7mm visual separation from source; source corner and generated surface retained separately.

landmarks.anatomy: Native distal phalanx proximal direction origin

modelIndicator.construction: Facet49 and facet92 define the actual proximal phalangeal axis; surface endpoint is a 4mm source-directed teaching construction.
limitations: Construction is not a measured skin crease.

landmarks.anatomy: Radial IP width boundary

modelIndicator.construction: Native proximal-phalangeal distal articulation facets define an authored thumb IP-level caliper. Full surface width at these addressed sides calibrates 1 F-cun; no source IP skin crease is asserted.
limitations: Teaching joint-width correspondence; individual skin crease and clinical finger-cun accuracy not established.
